items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: And the band was, uh, Red Long, Chink, Angelo Palmasana, on the banjo. Joe Law, Joe Law, Canada guy that's got the, the hot dog wagons, on saxophone, and myself. And, uh, the name of that band was, Glenn Lee Long, and his New Orleans Swing Band.

ctx.x: And then, and then that, they didn't like that so much. And even a little piano, according, and his mother played in, played real fine church piano, you know. And, uh, his sister played piano and sang, uh, spirituals. And he had an uncle who's quite well known as an author. His name is Kennedy, Emmett Kennedy. He's written a lot of books and things like that. And he was, he was a piano player, too. It's just natural in, in the family, you see. And, uh, then, once he hit the carnet, well, and he, and he never did…
Did you know he had any lessons around here? He studied from Manuel Mineta.
